items.headline: Air Force hosts Navy
items.description: Navy (1-2) at Air Force (2-1), Oct. 3 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Rocco Conti's TD run lifts Air Force to 36-33 victory over Nevada in 2OT
items.description: — Rocco Conti scored on a 7-yard run in the second overtime and Air Force rallied last in a 36-33 victory over Nevada on Saturday night in the Wolf Pack's Mountain West Conference opener.

items.headline: Air Force and Nevada meet in MWC action
items.description: Air Force (1-1) at Nevada (1-2), Sept. 26 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: What are the longest field goals in college football history?
items.description: Ove Johansson kicked the longest field goal in college football history, with a 69-yard zinger. Check out the other top field goals of all time now.

items.headline: North Dakota St. beats Air Force 38-32, win first Mountain West Conference game
items.description: — Nathan Hayes threw two touchdown passes and scored on a 17-yard run, and North Dakota State beat Air Force 38-32 on Saturday night in the Bison's first Mountain West Conference game.

items.headline: North Dakota State squares off against Air Force in MWC action
items.description: North Dakota State (2-0) at Air Force (1-0), Sept. 12 at 10 p.m. EDT.
